text:
Harper: dropping a quick design ask  added a 'Connection health ribbon' to the private setup wizard network step. figma: /designs/onprem/health-ribbon. want fast UX + a11y + privacy reads before handoff.
Zain: saw it. love the ribbon idea to surface overall status. keep the ribbon copy very short: 'Connection status: Blocked' or 'Connection status: Good'. follow that with a single line explanation.
Claire: for blocked state, the next line should be action-oriented: 'Try opening outbound port 443 or enable proxy bypass for redwood-inference-api'. avoid jargon like 'egress'.
a11y-bot: a11y notes: 1) the ribbon must not rely on color alone; include plain text and an icon; 2) announce changes via role="status" + aria-live="polite"; 3) ensure ribbon contrast >= 4.5:1.
Harper: one UX tweak: ribbon should persist at top of the wizard step so users don't miss it when scrolling. clicking the ribbon expands a small panel with suggested fixes and a 'Run quick check' CTA.
Zain: for the quick check, label it 'Quick check (<20s)' and show an inline timeline: 'probing -> analyzing -> summary' rather than a spinner. keeps the page context.
Claire: privacy: any 'Share diagnostics' flow must show a sample redacted payload. privacy-bot can recommend what to redact. Also avoid sending hostnames unless hashed.
privacy-bot: recommendation: default analytics include only summarized hop counts and error codes. Full traceroutes or hostnames are sent to support only after explicit consent; present a clear confirm modal and list included fields.
Harper: copy for confirm modal draft: 'Share anonymized diagnostics with Redwood Support (no credentials). This will include a summarized traceroute and error codes. You can redact hostnames.' include link to privacy page.
Zain: UI detail: in collapsed 'technical details', show the probe as monospace, collapsed by default with a small 'Copy' button. also provide an option 'Download bundle' for SREs.
a11y-bot: ensure the 'Copy' control is keyboard focusable and announces 'Copied' via polite aria-live. modal must trap focus and restore focus on close.
Claire: mobile note: ribbon should be slim and tappable; expansion panel full-screen on small devices. stack copy and download actions vertically.
Harper: acceptance for eng: 1) persistent connection ribbon with accessible labels; 2) quick vs full check endpoints and progress timeline; 3) collapsed technical details with copy and download; 4) consent modal describing redaction and data fields; 5) telemetry defaults to summarized-only.
Zain: i'll update figma components and add the timeline micro-animation.
privacy-bot: i'll draft the sample redacted payload and share wording for the confirm modal.
Harper: thanks team  aiming for dev handoff tomorrow. tagging @zain for final copy tweaks. :white_check_mark:
